scope: Joint review covering the BOM, not a validated assembly sequence. All installation trajectories are withheld until subassembly order, final fit and swept clearances are established.

steps.title: Fixture the main housing
surfaces: Housing front mounting face
Assembly fixture locating face
steps.process: Locate the housing coaxially; establish an axial datum before installing internal subassemblies. Fixture is not modeled.
steps.check: Confirm datum, clamping distortion and access to both ends.

pathReview.reason: Fixture setup has no installation trajectory. Define housing datums and fixture access first.

steps.title: Locate the fixed ring and stator carrier
surfaces: Ring flange front face, z = 13.25 mm
Housing internal front seat, z = 13.25 mm
steps.process: Align the eight threaded positions on the 54 mm pitch circle. Axial motion is illustrative; insertion access needs checking.
steps.check: Validate locating diameter, face flatness and assembly access.

pathReview.reason: The ring flange and integral stator sleeve must pass the housing entry and internal shoulders. No swept-volume check or insertion-side decision exists.

steps.title: Fasten the ring to the housing
surfaces: Screw head cones ↔ housing countersinks
Screw threads ↔ eight ring flange tapped holes
steps.process: Seat heads and tighten in a cross pattern. Thread proposal is M2.5 × 0.45; nominal penetration 3.3 mm. Torque is unspecified.
steps.check: Check thread engagement, bottoming, preload and tool clearance. Recheck screw tips if motor stack moves forward.

pathReview.reason: Each of the eight screws needs its own axis, head approach and driver access. Translating all screws from one global direction was incorrect.

steps.title: Apply the stator retaining bond
surfaces: Carrier sleeve OD 51.96 mm
Stator bore ID 52 mm
steps.process: Apply the proposed retaining compound uniformly; the nominal radial bond gap is 0.02 mm. Grade and cure are unspecified.
steps.check: Verify adhesive compatibility, coverage, shear capacity and thermal path.

pathReview.reason: Adhesive is dispensed onto a prepared sleeve; it is not a rigid ring that can be translated through the housing.

steps.title: Build and seat the lamination stack
surfaces: Each coated lamination face ↔ next coated face
Stack bore ↔ carrier sleeve; stack front face ↔ shoulder at z = 6.936 mm
steps.process: Illustrate 68 individual 0.20 mm sheets with 2 µm coating per face. Align slots using tooling; define whether the stack is preassembled before bonding.
steps.check: Gross stack 13.872 mm. Check cumulative thickness, burr orientation, insulation and axial retention.

pathReview.reason: Build the coated stack in a separate fixture, then evaluate installation of the completed stator subassembly. Individual sheets cannot be sent through an installed housing and shoulder.

steps.title: Insulate the winding slots
surfaces: Slot liners ↔ steel slot walls
End insulation ↔ lamination end faces
steps.process: Insert liners without damage; end insulation and folds require detailed design.
steps.check: Specify dielectric rating, thickness, creepage and slot fill.

pathReview.reason: Install and form insulation on the accessible stator subassembly before housing installation. Liner insertion and end folds are not modeled.

steps.title: Install the three-phase winding
surfaces: Copper conductor insulation ↔ slot insulation
End turns ↔ reserved end-winding space (clearance, not a locating joint)
steps.process: Wind or insert coils using a validated winding schedule, then route phase ends. Coil forming and insertion require a separate process model.
steps.check: Turns, wire gauge, connection pattern, tooling and end-turn envelope are not released.

pathReview.reason: Wind the insulated stator outside the closed housing. Rigid translation of finished coils through teeth does not represent a winding process.

steps.title: Attach the winding sensor
surfaces: Sensor sensing surface ↔ winding thermal contact area
Sensor leads ↔ driver temperature input
steps.process: Locate the sensor against a representative winding hot spot; attachment and lead route are unspecified.
steps.check: Confirm sensor type, isolation, retention and calibration.

pathReview.reason: Attach the sensor while the winding and lead route are accessible, before impregnation or final closure as the selected process requires.

steps.title: Impregnate and cure the winding
surfaces: Resin ↔ conductor bundle and slot insulation
Resin ↔ accessible stack surfaces
steps.process: Impregnate after electrical checks and cure to the selected resin process. The displayed resin ring is only a placeholder.
steps.check: Specify resin, masking, cure cycle and post-cure insulation tests.

pathReview.reason: Impregnation and curing are material processes on the wound stator, not translation of a solid resin ring.

steps.title: Prepare the rotor yoke and end bell
surfaces: Yoke/end-bell junction (joining design unresolved)
Rotor outer swept envelope ↔ housing and boss clearance
steps.process: Inspect rotor subassembly outside the housing. No rotor installation route has been validated.
steps.check: Extended housing bosses intersect the current yoke. Resolve before assembly.

pathReview.reason: Build the rotor as a separate subassembly. The current yoke intersects housing bosses at the final position, so no valid installation path can end there.

steps.title: Apply magnet adhesive
surfaces: Adhesive ↔ yoke inner cylindrical wall
Adhesive ↔ magnet outer cylindrical backs
steps.process: Prepare surfaces and dispense a controlled bondline; adhesive and mechanical retention are unspecified.
steps.check: Qualify bond thickness, temperature capability, cure and centrifugal retention.

pathReview.reason: Dispense adhesive on the accessible rotor yoke before magnet placement; do not animate adhesive as a preformed inserted ring.

steps.title: Locate the rotor magnets
surfaces: Magnet backs ↔ bonded yoke inner wall
Magnet side faces ↔ pole-spacing fixture
steps.process: Place alternating poles using tooling and cure. 42 pieces are assumed; OEM magnet segmentation is unconfirmed.
steps.check: Verify polarity, spacing, concentricity, retention and air gap; do not infer piece count from pole count.

pathReview.reason: Place magnets individually in the open rotor using polarity and spacing fixtures. Their placement directions and capture clearances have not been designed.

steps.title: Couple the input hub
surfaces: Hub rotor attachment surface ↔ rotor end bell
Hub bore ↔ sun/input shaft interface
steps.process: Show the hub in its reference position. A press fit, key, spline or fasteners have not been established.
steps.check: Define torque path, axial retention, fit, runout and balance before choosing an assembly operation.

pathReview.reason: The hub-to-end-bell joint has no defined fastening or fit. Define the torque connection before deciding sequence, direction or required tools.

steps.title: Install the input support bearings
surfaces: 6701 bearing inner races ↔ input hub journals
Bearing outer races ↔ stationary support bores (seat ownership to confirm)
steps.process: Position the two reference bearings; identify actual seats and shoulders before specifying a pressing operation.
steps.check: If an interference fit is chosen, apply force to the fitted race. Fits, preload, retention and seat geometry remain open.

pathReview.reason: The two bearings require individually identified seats, shoulders, fit and press-tool access. A shared axial translation cannot establish installation order.

steps.title: Couple the sun gear and shaft
surfaces: Sun/input shaft coupling land ↔ input hub bore
Shaft support interfaces ↔ bearing arrangement to confirm
steps.process: Locate the 20-tooth sun at the 8.25 mm gear plane. Coupling geometry is not a verified torque connection.
steps.check: Resolve shaft/hub connection and retention. Tooth profile study does not validate the entire transmission.

pathReview.reason: The sun shaft coupling and axial retention are undefined. Its enlarged gear and journal sections require a seat-by-seat insertion check.

steps.title: Prepare the planet supports
surfaces: Planet pin locating ends ↔ output carrier pin seats
Pin axial retention ↔ carrier faces
steps.process: Prepare the carrier subassembly with three pins; the modeled carrier lacks a validated pin retention design.
steps.check: Specify carrier bores, pin fits, shoulders and retention; verify load capacity.

pathReview.reason: Prepare pins in a separate carrier subassembly. The previous sequence showed pins mating to a carrier that was not yet installed. Pin bores and retention remain undefined.

steps.title: Install planet bearings or bushings
surfaces: Bearing or bushing inner surface ↔ planet pin OD
Outer surface ↔ planet gear bore
steps.process: Locate the three provisional supports on pins. Bearing versus bushing selection is still open.
steps.check: Define diametral clearance or interference, lubrication and axial restraint.

pathReview.reason: Determine whether each support is assembled into the planet bore first or onto its pin first from the selected fits and access; no common path is established.

steps.title: Install and phase the planets
surfaces: Planet bore ↔ bearing or bushing OD
70-tooth planet flanks ↔ 20-tooth sun and 160-tooth ring flanks
steps.process: Align the three planets to the modeled phase before engagement. Tooth-by-tooth insertion access is unverified.
steps.check: Fixed ring, sun input, carrier output gives 9:1. Backlash, root manufacture, strength and tolerance validation remain open.

pathReview.reason: Prepare planet/support/pin/carrier relationships and phase all three planets before engagement with sun and ring. Gear phase alone does not validate insertion.

steps.title: Install output support bearings
surfaces: Bearing inner races ↔ rotating output support journals
Bearing outer races ↔ stationary housing seats (confirm each seat)
steps.process: Locate 625-ZZ and 6707-ZZ reference bearings. Identify race shoulders and retention from detailed sections.
steps.check: Specify fits, load path, axial play or preload, retention and installation force path.

pathReview.reason: Identify each bearing seat owner and shoulder before choosing installation direction and whether the bearing belongs on a shaft or in a housing first.

steps.title: Seat the output carrier
surfaces: Carrier planet supports ↔ pins
Carrier bearing lands ↔ output support races
steps.process: Bring the carrier subassembly into final reference position. Pin preparation is shown separately for clarity.
steps.check: Carrier/pin and bearing retention require detailed design; sequence and access are not proven.

pathReview.reason: Carrier insertion must move its retained pins, planet supports and planets as the chosen subassembly, not the carrier alone through them. Retention is unresolved.

steps.title: Apply gearbox lubricant
surfaces: Lubricant ↔ sun, planet and ring working flanks
Lubricant ↔ selected planet support contact surfaces
steps.process: Apply the selected lubricant before closing the housing. Displayed volume is an illustrative extent.
steps.check: Specify lubricant grade, dose, compatibility, life and contamination control.

pathReview.reason: Apply lubricant to accessible working surfaces at the appropriate assembly stage; it is not a rigid inserted disk.

steps.title: Define seals, shims and locking provisions
surfaces: Seal ↔ designed groove and counterface (not yet defined)
Shims ↔ bearing or shoulder stack as required
steps.process: Resolve these provisions before closure; the torus shown is a placeholder, not a specified seal.
steps.check: Define grooves, squeeze, shim stack and thread-lock locations; do not purchase from this geometry.

pathReview.reason: Select and model actual seals, grooves, shims and locking locations before defining their operations. A generic torus does not define assembly.

steps.title: Close the rear housing
surfaces: Rear housing flange ↔ main housing rear joint face
Rear housing interior ↔ rotating end bell (required non-contact clearance)
steps.process: Show closure up to the reference position; the current rotor end bell intersects the rear housing.
steps.check: Measured intersection 2666.28 mm³. Redesign axial packaging and verify winding clearance before closure.

pathReview.reason: The end bell intersects the rear housing in the final position. Closure cannot be validated until this overlap and the bearing/lead access are resolved.

steps.title: Fasten the rear housing
surfaces: Screw head cones ↔ rear housing countersinks
Screw threads ↔ main housing boss bores
steps.process: Align the rear housing and tighten in a cross pattern only after clearance redesign. Torque remains unspecified.
steps.check: Validate boss threads, engagement, bottoming, preload, cutter access and rotor clearance.

pathReview.reason: Each rear screw needs an individual axis and tool clearance after rear-housing closure is physically feasible. Current rotor/housing conflicts block this operation.

steps.title: Attach the encoder target
surfaces: Encoder magnet mounting face ↔ rotating hub target seat
Magnet sensing face ↔ encoder sensing axis (non-contact)
steps.process: Center and retain the target magnet; adhesive or other retention must be specified.
steps.check: Validate retention, magnetic orientation, runout and encoder air gap.

pathReview.reason: Define magnet seat, retention and access on the hub before fitting the encoder board; verify sensing gap after closure.

steps.title: Populate and inspect the driver
steps.method: PCB solder assembly / capacitor mounting unresolved
surfaces: Component terminals ↔ PCB pads
Connector leads ↔ PCB pads; connector bodies ↔ mechanical support
Encoder sensing face ↔ target magnet (non-contact)
steps.process: Populate and reflow per a qualified PCB assembly process; connect the bulk capacitor as specified. 205 inventory designators are data-only; displayed package locations are illustrative.
steps.check: Confirm footprints, solder process, pinout, capacitor mounting, power isolation and encoder alignment. No duplicate external harness is added.

pathReview.reason: Populate the PCB as a separate subassembly. Components are soldered to pads, not moved through an installed board. Positions of most inventory items are unmapped.

steps.title: Mount and connect the driver board
steps.method: PCB mounting and electrical termination unresolved
surfaces: PCB mounting holes ↔ rear support points
Motor phase ends ↔ driver phase terminals; sensor leads ↔ temperature input
Encoder ↔ rotating magnet sensing gap
steps.process: Mount the tested board and terminate winding/sensor leads. Board fastening details, routing and strain relief must be designed.
steps.check: Check standoffs, fastener lengths, insulation, rotor clearance, connector access and encoder gap.

pathReview.reason: Move a populated board together with its attached components. Define standoffs, phase/sensor lead termination, strain relief and connector access first.

steps.title: Install the driver cover
surfaces: Cover rim ↔ rear housing or mounting support face
Cover interior ↔ driver component clearance
steps.process: Locate the cover without loading PCB components or capacitor. Exact support and sealing interfaces need confirmation.
steps.check: Check electronics keep-out, connector openings and thermal provisions.

pathReview.reason: Check cover swept clearance against the populated driver, capacitor and connectors. Its locating and sealing interfaces remain unconfirmed.

steps.title: Fasten the driver cover
surfaces: Screw head seats ↔ driver cover
Screw threads ↔ receiving support holes (ownership and thread depth to confirm)
steps.process: Insert the six reference screws; verify the receiving threaded part before release.
steps.check: Torque, engagement, bottoming and PCB clearance are unspecified.

pathReview.reason: Identify the receiving threaded support, individual screw axes, insertion side and driver access for all six screws.

steps.title: Install the closure cover and inspect
surfaces: Closure cover locating surface ↔ output carrier opening
Closure face ↔ carrier seat
steps.process: Locate the source cover. Define its retention and sealing before final inspection.
steps.check: Check free rotation, axial play, insulation, phase continuity, encoder function and loaded operation only after the geometry blockers are resolved.

pathReview.reason: Define cover retention and mating opening before choosing a path. Final checks require resolved mechanical and electrical assembly.
